turns.user_utterance: I tried to pay at the shop, but the machine says my secret number is wrong and the card just stops working.
turns.assistant_response: It sounds like the card is failing because the PIN/secret number is being rejected—often this can mean the PIN is entered incorrectly too many times and the PIN gets blocked. Can you confirm: are you still able to use the card for purchases, or does it always fail at the payment terminal with the same message?

turns.user_utterance: It always fails, same message every time I try to pay.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if every shop payment fails with the same “secret number/PIN wrong” message, the PIN is likely blocked. I can help you unblock/reset it. Have you tried entering the PIN multiple times, and do you still have access to your card’s PIN (or have you forgotten it)?
